description: Set up the design system foundation: tailwind.config.ts with custom tokens, globals.css with CSS variables and base typography, layout.tsx with Google Fonts (Zen Kaku Gothic New 300/500, DM Mono 400), and restyle the three UI primitives (ErrorMessage, LoadingSpinner, Toast) to follow the One Filled Thing style guide.
steps: Update tailwind.config.ts to define custom colors (paper: #F6F5F1, rule: #E6E4DC, live: #A8512C, ink: #1C1C1A, live-wash: #F1E6E0), ink opacity variants (ink-72, ink-50, ink-35), spacing scale (s-1 through s-6: 8, 16, 24, 40, 64, 104), fontFamily entries for 'zen' (Zen Kaku Gothic New) and 'mono' (DM Mono), fontSize entries matching the type scale (display 76px, h1 42px, h2 30px, h3 24px, body 16px/27px, list 15px/21px, meta 11px/18px), borderRadius of 0 globally, and remove any default shadow utilities.

Rewrite src/app/globals.css to define CSS custom properties (--paper, --rule, --live, --ink, --ink-72, --ink-50, --ink-35, --live-wash, spacing --s-1 through --s-6, --radius: 0, --target-min: 44px, --dur-fast: 180ms, --dur: 240ms, --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.3,1)), set body background to var(--paper), text color to var(--ink), font-family to Zen Kaku Gothic New, add @media (prefers-reduced-motion) rule setting all durations to 0, keep the existing print styles and safe-area-pb utility, remove animate-pulse-once keyframe.

Update src/app/layout.tsx to import Zen Kaku Gothic New (weights 300, 500) and DM Mono (weight 400) from next/font/google. Apply the zen font class to <html> or <body>, expose the mono font via a CSS variable (--font-mono). Set body className to use the paper background.

Restyle src/components/ui/ErrorMessage.tsx: remove rounded-lg, bg-red-50, border-red-200 coloring. Use 1px border-rule on top only, ink text at ink-72 opacity, no background fill. Dismiss button is an underlined word meeting 44px target.

Restyle src/components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx: remove rounded-full colored borders. Use a simple 1px ink-colored border spinner with no fill colors, or a minimal text indicator. No animation that is ambient (respect prefers-reduced-motion).

Restyle src/components/ui/Toast.tsx: remove bg-green-600/bg-red-600/bg-blue-600 fills, rounded-lg, shadow-lg. Make it a bottom-positioned bar with 1px rule border on top, paper background, ink text. Use 240ms ease transition for appear/disappear. No color fills.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.ts contains all custom token definitions matching the style guide
globals.css defines all CSS custom properties listed in the tokens section
layout.tsx imports both fonts from next/font/google and applies them
All three UI components (ErrorMessage, LoadingSpinner, Toast) have zero rounded corners, zero shadows, zero colored fills, zero emoji
npm run build succeeds with no errors
